description.value:
You touch the powers of the divine to expand your horizons. Select one of the following Domains: Fate, Luck, Secrecy, Star, Time and Truth. You gain the initial Domain spell for the chosen Domain, which you cast as a Foreteller spell.

When you cast a Foreteller spell from one of these Domains, you can Draw and Play a card from your hand; this grants the spell the Cardplay trait. If the suit of the card Played is the of the Charisma suit, you gain a hint of cosmic insight from touching upon a divine domain and regain the Focus point used to cast the spell. If the suit of the card Played is of the Constitution suit, you feel ire from a divine source for your attempt and @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.arhOfryj6gDtqwZO]{Effect: Bust!}.
